entities.text: B. N. Vilas vs The State Of Telanagana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.14454 of 2023
Order:

The present writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Mandamus by declaring the action of the respondents in carrying out the work of Road widening in Birkur Town Road without following the due process of law and without issuing notice to the petitioners for acquiring the land, as illegal arbitrary and violation of principles of natural justice and consequently direct the respondents to follow the due process of law for carrying out the Road widening work by issuing notice to the petitioners for acquiring the land and by paying the compensation."
2. The petitioners claim to be the absolute owners of the land, admeasuring Ac.0.10 guntas, in Survey No.753/A, situated at Birkur Village and Mandal, Kamareddy District, having purchased the same under a registered sale deed vide Document No.6508 of 2015 dated 25.03.2015.
3.

The main grievance of the petitioners is that the respondents are proposing to widen the existing 66 feet road in Birkur Town, without initiating any proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and that the said road widening is likely to deprive the petitioners of a major portion of their land.
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings, based on the written instructions dated 09.06.2023 submitted by respondent No.3 - Executive Engineer (R&B) Division,
Kamareddy

, has submitted that the Government vide G.O.Rt.No.07 T(R&B) R-II dated 07.01.2023 has accorded administrative sanction for an amount of Rs.7.20 Crores for widening the road from double lane to four lanes in Birkur Town limits.

Learned Government Pleader has further submitted that respondent authorities have not taken up any widening work at the lands belonging to the petitioners situated at Birkur and that they will take up the work of road widening from two lanes to four lanes within Right of Way of 66 feet by following due process of law.

5. Recording the above submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents to follow due process of law, in case the land of the petitioners is required for the purpose of road widening.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
C.V.BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 12.06.2023 va B. N. Vilas vs The State Of Telanagana on 12 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129379668/
